description_en: Queries the result of an interactive command in a cluster
description_zh: 调用ListInvocationResults查看指定集群内交互命令的运行结果
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc list-invocation-results --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --command-id c-hz01v8x80o30000 --invoke-record-status Finished --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --instance Id=i-uf65bh2113hlqvyr0000 --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListInvocationResults

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html operation to query the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html获取集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the command.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87388.html operation to query the command ID
parameters.help_zh:
命令ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87388.html获取命令ID
parameters.name: command_id

parameters.help_en:
The status of the command that you want to query. Valid values:

Finished
Running
Failed
Stopped
parameters.help_zh:
需要查询的命令的运行状态。取值范围：
Finished：已结束
Running：运行中
Failed：运行失败
Stopped：已停止
parameters.name: invoke_record_status

parameters.help_en:
The number of the page to return.

Page numbers start from 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
当前页码。

起始值：1

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 50.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
每页显示的行数。取值范围：1~50

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

element_fields.help_en:
The ID of the node on which the command is run.

The Instance.N.Id parameter specifies the node on which the command is run. If it is not specified, the command is run on all nodes of the cluster
element_fields.help_zh:
第N个执行命令的目标节点实例ID。
用于限定执行范围，不指定则默认在集群所有节点上执行
element_fields.name: id

parameters.help_en: The information of nodes on which the command is run
parameters.help_zh: 执行命令的目标节点信息列表
parameters.name: instance
